item.title: Spritesheet
item.description: There are two ways to begin making a sprite. select a imagesheet in asset table then select a layer by clicing _target property. select a layer for spritesheet replacement, then click spritesheet replacement tool, and select a spritesheet image by clicing _filename property. Spitesheet has one of sheetType uniform-sized a png file. you need to set each width/height of sprite manually in the properties panel. texture packer the pair if imagesheet png and lua (frames data). You can specify the lua file in sheetInfo property.
